design.rationale: October design (docs/adsb_nn2/design_report.json): nmres is worse alone (173.1-174.7 s vs base 170.7-172.6) and as a partner (equal-compute mean of base 1..k + nmres 1..k loses to base 1..2k at every k = 1..4 by 0.17-0.26 pp on the committee blend, 0.12-0.16 pp on the recipe proxy) -> the declared rule gives further nnb seeds. nnl's single-seed non-LIRF blend readings (-0.78%, -0.68%) do not both lie inside the eight base seeds' range (-0.73 ... -1.00%) -> nnl does not join the committee pool. On October LIRF non-population rows against the cross-fitted v9 the two-seed nnl mean is worse alone (376.7 vs 360.3) but blends: matched best at 0.2 (355.5 -> 353.4), unmatched best at 0.5 (368.2 -> 358.5, -2.6%) -> the LIRF weights are declared per scope, the network taking weight from the tree table on matched rows (c in 0.15, 0.3) and from v9 on unmatched rows (c in 0.25, 0.5), where v24's structure would otherwise cap any table at 0.25.

configuration.development_scheme: Every declared seed is fitted like v24's networks: seasonal fold (predicts January/July 2025), forward fold (November), January-November refit (December, written to the December leaf cache). Seed means by tools/ensemble_adsb_full.py. On each of the four months the v24 recipe is rebuilt exactly as adsb_nn_v1 rebuilt nn50, with the committee table's network replaced by the candidate's pool and, on the two LIRF blend scopes, explicit (v9, tree table, network) weights: matched (0.15, 0.85 - c, c), the network taking weight from the tree table; unmatched (0.75 - c, 0.25, c), the network taking weight from v9 (the October design reading's competitor there). The control must reproduce nn50's recorded development RMSE.

configuration.purpose: Further network members for the v24 recipe. (1) The committee-table network pool doubles from 16 to 32 seeds (new seeds: nnb); the October seed curve was still improving at 8. (2) LIRF rows are untouched by v24's network (it never saw LIRF); a network fitted with LIRF's ordinary rows (nnl) enters the LIRF table on both LIRF blend scopes. LIRF is 29-45% of the development SSE outside January.
configuration.selection: A candidate is eligible when: no recipe month is worse on ALL rows (ratio to the control <= 1.0); the mean ratio over the four recipe months is at least 0.02% below 1; and on every month where it changes a row the paired-day bootstrap 95% interval of the RMSE difference against the control lies below zero. Among eligible candidates choose the lowest mean ratio (ties by name); otherwise select nothing and keep v24. The rule of adsb_v25/v26/v27/nn/v29, unchanged.
configuration.ship: If a candidate is selected: every seed of every ensemble the candidate uses is refit on January-December 2025 at the same epoch budget (--fold refit12); ranking tables are the seed means; the shipped v24 ranking values are rebuilt from their recorded components with the control's tables and must reproduce the uploaded v24 exactly; then the selected pools are applied, exported as the next version through the frozen submission contract, verified independently (every saved network reloaded and re-predicted on its cached inputs), audited (tools/audit_export.py), and uploaded only with the user's approval. The twelve-month refits may start as development chains finish, before the selection, for scheduling only; they are used only if the selection needs them.
